_note: Eldwin's slice progression (docs/05-combat.md). Each level's `xp` is the total needed to reach it. `afterWinMp` is the share of max MP a win gives back. `pointsPerLevel` is the upgrade points each level earns (ranks are in skills.json). `typicalFoeRes` is the foe the Upgrades page's rough damage figures assume. Icon names are drawn icons in src/ui/icons.ts.

defeat.line: Eldwin is too worn to go on.
defeat.hint: Spells can be swapped at a hearth, and a group he sees coming can be walked around.
